title: A needs-clarification draft is approved at the post-plan checkpoint
intent: Pin the HITL post-plan checkpoint on the approve branch: one audit record, then a second draft that is ready.

input.featureRequest: Accept a new optional config block and validate it.

request.userPrompt: Accept a new optional config block and validate it.

questions: Where is the config parsed today?
What happens to an unknown block?
Is there a typed error class already?
researchDoc.findings: The parser lives in src/config/parse.ts and drops unknown blocks silently; ConfigError already exists.

sections.architecture: One parse entry point, called from the CLI and from the library surface.
sections.patterns: Zod schemas per block, composed at the top level.
sections.conventions: Typed errors extend ConfigError and carry the offending key.
sections.risks: Silently dropping unknown blocks means a typo is invisible today.

assumptions: The fixture repository is a TypeScript package with Vitest.

clarificationQuestions.question: May the block appear more than once?
clarificationQuestions.recommendation: Assume at most once; the schema is an object today.

acceptanceCriteria: A malformed block produces a typed error rather than a crash.
